error.message: agent planning stopped on terminal missing executable inputs

phase_failures.message: planner payload failed planner_ir_v1 schema validation

violations.expected: Planner IR may not compile an executable workflow while required input 'sequence' is still missing. Known inputs:

Root tool 'esm3' node 'generate_candidate' is missing required executable inputs ['candidates', 'sequence']. Known inputs: []. Valid root inputs: ['sequence']. Use a resolver/lookup producer first when exact identifiers are absent.
Tool 'esm3' node 'generate_candidate' is missing required input fields ['candidates', 'sequence']. Known inputs: []. Valid root inputs: ['sequence'].

structured_error.fix_instruction: Re-emit the Planner IR JSON. Use version planner_ir_v1, semantic nodes, literal scalar inputs, and upstream entries whose relationship is candidate_source or term_source. Do not emit executor wiring or decision-time submission nodes.

payload.goal: Generate one small soluble de novo protein candidate, evaluate its sequence and structure, perform basic QC, and rank the result.
assumptions: ESM3 iterative masked generation is the appropriate de novo backbone+sequence co-generation step given available tools.
A single generated candidate satisfies the 'at most one' constraint; no combinatorial expansion is needed.
The structure track predicted by ESM3 is sufficient for structure analysis without a separate refold step.
Physiological pH 7.4 is appropriate for charge, pI, and GRAVY solubility assessment.
Small soluble proteins are expected to have low instability index, negative GRAVY, no polybasic patches, and reasonable pLDDT.
A seed or masked sequence encoding desired length and optional fixed anchors must be supplied at execution time to initialise ESM3 iterative generation.

missing_inputs.name: sequence
missing_inputs.reason: ESM3 is the root generation node and requires a seed or masked sequence (encoding desired length and any fixed anchors) to begin iterative de novo generation; none was provided in known_inputs. This is a required executable input for the root node.

nodes.intent: Iteratively generate a small de novo protein candidate, co-producing sequence token logits and a predicted backbone structure via the sequence and structure tracks.
Compute composition, pH-dependent charge, motif liabilities (deamidation, oxidation, isomerization), and per-residue biochemical annotations for the generated sequence.
Assess per-residue solvent exposure, buried/surface classification, and secondary-structure assignment from the ESM3-predicted structure.
Compute lightweight QC scalars—pLDDT, GRAVY, instability index, pI, and polybasic-patch flag—as a cheap pre-filter for solubility and stability before ranking.
Aggregate sequence analysis, structure analysis, and QC results into a deterministically ranked top-1 candidate list.

finalization.ranking_preference: prefer candidate with high pLDDT, negative GRAVY (hydrophilic/soluble), low instability index (<40), neutral-to-acidic pI, and no polybasic patches
